When the operation used supports team colour, which means skins that don't use team coloured textures can have this. So you should be able to have team coloured textures implimented on any texture of any skin that has this, even if the skin itself doesn't use team colour.
Texture rotation is locked to a specific value.
More commonly known as albedo tint, its what gives certain skins their metalic shine.
When parts of the weapon are exposed (Completely different from albedo tint).
Also known as Random Stickers, allows for multiple stickers to be used in the same slot, (An example of this is the ballonicorn crest on certain Gentlemanne's skins).
